paragraphs._1: These rules define the terms for returns and complaints in the HappyDate service. By placing an order, the customer accepts the terms of these rules. HappyDate acts as an intermediary between the customer and the Partner, unless expressly stated otherwise.

items._1: HappyDate is responsible for customer service, accepting complaints, organizing delivery (HappyDate Courier) and settlements.
items._2: The Partner bears full responsibility for the quality, conformity and completeness of the goods, and in the case of an accepted quality complaint covers the cost of re-fulfillment or refund of the product value.
items._3: HappyDate Courier is responsible for timely and proper delivery, and in the event of damage is obliged to compensate within the scope of the delivery cost.

paragraphs._1: HappyDate’s total liability toward the customer is limited to the value of the placed order.

paragraphs._2: Returns are possible only for durable products (e.g. handmade gifts), provided they were not used and have original packaging. The return shipping cost is borne by the customer unless the return results from the Partner’s fault.

items._1: quickly perishable products (e.g. flowers, cakes, food),
items._2: services provided on a specified date (e.g. animations, deliveries at a fixed hour).

paragraphs._2: The complaint must be submitted within 24 hours of delivery. After this deadline, complaints may be rejected. The Partner undertakes to re-fulfill the order or cover the product cost. HappyDate reserves the right to refuse a refund if the complaint is unfounded.

items._1: Delay caused by HappyDate Courier – refund of delivery cost, without refund of the product price.
items._2: Delay caused by the Partner – the Partner may be charged compensation costs for the customer.
items._3: Customer error (e.g. wrong address, no recipient) – re-delivery paid 100%, if the customer wishes re-fulfillment.

paragraphs._1: Complaints should be submitted within 24 hours of delivery through the HappyDate application, the email address reklamacje@happydate.pl or the hotline. HappyDate reviews complaints within 48 business hours.
paragraphs._2: Complaints must be documented (e.g. a product photo). Lack of evidence may result in rejection of the complaint.

paragraphs._1: Refunds are made using the same payment method, within up to 14 business days from acceptance of the complaint. The refund does not include additional service costs (e.g. personalization, night delivery), unless the defect directly concerns those services.

items._1: HappyDate is not liable for delays resulting from force majeure (e.g. weather conditions, system failures).
items._2: HappyDate is not liable for the customer’s individual preferences (e.g. color, shape, taste), if the product matches the general description.
items._3: HappyDate is not liable for services provided by the Partner outside the platform.

paragraphs._1: HappyDate reserves the right to modify these rules. The current version is always available on the website. In matters not regulated, Polish law applies.
